title: Gold Board State
description: A hand-authored test fixture for Validation Gate 2 (docs/VALIDATION_GATES.md). Lives in rules_tests/gold_board_states/<id>.json. Per docs/RUN_CLASSIFICATION.md, this is always a SYNTHETIC_* run - it may never contribute to deck-performance statistics regardless of how faithful its setup looks.

run_class.description: Always SYNTHETIC_GOLD_STATE for this schema - see docs/RUN_CLASSIFICATION.md. A gold board state is by definition a laboratory fixture, never a deck-backed run.

representative_of_deck_draws.description: Always false - present explicitly per docs/RUN_CLASSIFICATION.md so a reader never has to infer it.

synthetic_mana.description: Whether mana sources in this fixture are arbitrary stand-ins (e.g. generic basics) rather than the subject deck's actual mana base.

artificial_state_elements.description: Free-text list of exactly which parts of the state are intentionally not deck-representative, e.g. 'Plains/Forest count and presence are arbitrary scaffolding, not the subject deck's actual land base'.

interaction_under_test.description: The specific rule/interaction being validated - an INT-#### id where applicable, or a Comprehensive Rules citation for a rules-only test.

material_characteristics.description: What about this state DOES matter to the result and must be faithful (e.g. 'Devoted Druid's toughness and creature-type status', 'Swift Reconfiguration's type-removal effect').

abstracted_characteristics.description: What's deliberately simplified because it doesn't affect the question under test (e.g. 'mana source identity - any W/G producer would do').

setup.description: Full board/zone state to initialize: per-player battlefield, hand, graveyard, exile, command zone, life, mana pool, priority holder, phase/step.

legal_actions.description: The complete expected legal-action set for the active/priority player.

illegal_actions_to_reject.description: Actions that must be correctly rejected — as important as what's legal.
